# Spaceezy

> Spaceezy is a real estate discovery platform for published projects and properties. The website presents live prices, configurations, availability, location information and direct enquiry paths so buyers can compare options before contacting the team.

This file expands on `llms.txt` with verified, public-facing information only. It does not describe private CRM dashboards, admin pages, APIs or internal documentation.

## About the business

Spaceezy was founded with the stated mission of making the journey of finding a home more transparent. The About page describes curated options, honest advice and end-to-end support for buyers looking at homes in cities or suburbs.

Publicly stated service points:

- Zero brokerage on partner and new developer projects.
- Dedicated relationship managers for site visits.
- Legal and documentation assistance.
- Post-sales support.
- Listings are described as verified, and project pages show RERA registration details where available.

Leadership listed publicly:

- Gaurav Sharma — Chief Executive Officer.
- Kamal — Founder.

## How the public website is organised

The site publishes two types of inventory pages: projects (developments) and properties (individual units). Location collections group the published inventory by place and property type. All pages use canonical `https://spaceezy.com` URLs.

## Real Estate CRM

Spaceezy CRM is the customer relationship management system used in Spaceezy's real estate operations. The following capabilities are implemented in the application:

- Website enquiry form creates or updates a lead with project, unit, configuration, location and preferred visit context.
- Lead pipeline stages, bulk assignment, claimable leads for executives, follow-up tasks, activity timelines and duplicate detection by phone number.
- Matching enquiries to properties using budget, configuration and preferred locations, with interest records kept on the lead.
- Project and configuration records, individually tracked units with area, price, status and versioning, plus bulk availability counters.
- Site visits scheduled against leads, projects or units, with scheduled, completed, cancelled and no-show states, a calendar and a missed-visits view.
- Bookings that update reservation status and track payment status; quotations with validity dates and an itemised PDF. No payment gateway is integrated.
- Customer records, call logging with outcomes, and a shared WhatsApp inbox tied to leads. Brochure and quotation PDFs can be attached to WhatsApp messages when the integration is configured.
- Meta Ads connection for campaigns, ad sets, creatives, audiences, Instant Form field mapping and lead sync; live behaviour depends on configured credentials.
- Five roles with server-enforced permissions and an audit trail.
- Reports derived from live lists and a productivity endpoint, with in-browser CSV export and browser-local custom templates.

The CRM is organised around sales executives, sales managers, administrators and channel partners. The application does not publish CRM prices, guarantee conversion rates, provide a customer self-service portal, calculate commissions, import lead spreadsheets, or integrate a payment gateway.

- [Real Estate CRM overview](https://spaceezy.com/real-estate-crm): Answers what a real estate CRM is, which capabilities matter and how Spaceezy teams use them.
- [Lead management](https://spaceezy.com/real-estate-crm/lead-management): Enquiry capture, stages, assignments, follow-ups, duplicates and matching.
- [Site visit management](https://spaceezy.com/real-estate-crm/site-visits): Scheduling, statuses and missed-visit follow-up.
- [Inventory management](https://spaceezy.com/real-estate-crm/inventory): Projects, configurations, units and availability records used in sales workflows.

## Homepage

- [Spaceezy](https://spaceezy.com/): The main entry point. It highlights featured projects and properties, location collections, the Spaceezy advantage and contact routes. The served area stated on the homepage is Ghaziabad.

## Projects

- [All projects](https://spaceezy.com/projects): A filterable overview of published real estate projects with pricing, configurations and availability.
- [Eligo Wave City](https://spaceezy.com/projects/eligo-wave-city-c28c62): Residential project in Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, developed by Wave Group / Wave Infratech. The page lists configurations, amenities, availability and RERA information.
- [Dream Homes](https://spaceezy.com/projects/dream-homes-e84e51): Residential project in Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, developed by Wave Group. The page lists 1 BHK, 2 BHK and 3 BHK configurations, amenities and RERA information.

## Properties

- [Eligo Wave City Tower 1 a302](https://spaceezy.com/properties/1c8bb75583bf3d60ee4ef27d02cd13ab): A 3 BHK unit in Eligo Wave City with area, price, amenities and availability information.
